entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I help you today?
Yeah, I'm calling about an order I just received. It's completely messed up.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the order?
Okay, VF789456. I see your order here. What seems to be the problem?
The bike I ordered is completely damaged! The frame is cracked. I think it's the frame; I don't know enough about bikes to be sure, but it looks like a cracked frame to me.
Oh no, I'm so sorry to hear about the cracked frame. That’s definitely not what we want. Could you describe the damage a bit more?

Well, besides the crack, the front wheel is completely wobbly. Like, dangerously wobbly. I wouldn't even think of riding it. It’s like it's not even attached correctly. I'm guessing it's shipping damage, but I don't know for sure.

It sounds like the bike sustained some serious shipping damage. I sincerely apologize for the condition your bike arrived in. What I can do is offer you a full refund for the bike and we can arrange for it to be picked up. We'll send you a free label for the return, of course.
A refund? That's it? I wanted the bike! I waited three weeks for this thing, and now you're telling me all you can do is give me my money back? I needed this bike for a race!

I understand your frustration, sir, and I am very sorry. Unfortunately, due to the extent of the shipping damage, we don't have the same model in stock currently to offer an exchange. However, I can offer you a discount on a similar bike if you'd like to consider a different model.
A discount? On a DIFFERENT bike? Do you even hear yourself? I wanted THAT bike! And now I have to settle for something else and pay MORE money? This is ridiculous!
Sir, I am doing everything I can to assist you. Let me check if there are any alternative solutions I can find. Please hold for a moment.
This is unbelievable. I'm losing my race because of this. What am I supposed to do now? Just sit at home?
Please hold, sir. I am still looking into available options for you…
You know what? Forget it! This is a waste of my time. I'm taking my business elsewhere!
Sir, please wait! I am trying to help...
